# StyleForge

StyleForge is an AI-powered image transformation platform. Unlike simple photo filters, every Style is powered by a carefully crafted AI prompt that controls composition, lighting, atmosphere, character details, color, and visual texture.

## Pages

### Home
https://www.styleforge.org/
The landing page introduces StyleForge's core value proposition: transform your images with AI Styles. Sections include:
- Hero: "Transform Your Images with AI"
- AI Image Transformation: three core features explained
- How It Works: three-step guide (Upload → Choose a Style → Transform with AI)
- Create Your Own Style: turn ideas into reusable AI Styles
- Powered by Carefully Crafted AI Prompts: before/after comparison showing how AI prompts drive transformations
- Explore AI Image Transformation Styles: curated style showcase with 7 featured styles
- Footer: navigation, support, legal links

### Image to Image
https://www.styleforge.org/image-to-image
The main tool page. Upload an image, choose a style from the categorized grid, and generate an AI transformation. Features:
- Left panel: image upload area with preview
- Right panel: style selector with category tabs (Trending, Character, Worlds, Creative)
- Generation progress with dynamic tips
- Before/after comparison slider
- IndexedDB cache for session recovery on refresh

### All Styles
https://www.styleforge.org/all-styles
Browse the complete catalog of AI image transformation styles. Search and filter by category. Each style card shows a preview image, style name, category, and credit cost. Click through to the style detail page.

### Create a Style
https://www.styleforge.org/create-style
Create a custom AI Style by describing the visual direction you want. Select a base model (FLUX Kontext Pro, Nano Banana 2, or GPT Image 2) and write a prompt that defines the transformation.

### Pricing
https://www.styleforge.org/pricing
Credit-based pricing plans. Free tier includes 40 credits to start. Plus and Pro plans offer more credits and additional features like HD generation, commercial use, and premium styles.

## AI Styles Catalog

### Trending
- Magazine Editorial: ultra-realistic fashion editorial with cinematic lighting
- Paparazzi: candid flash photography style

### Character
- Sticker Art: minimalist black-and-white hand-drawn sticker style
- Ink Illustration: minimalist ink illustration on matte paper

### Worlds
- Minecraft World: voxel block world transformation
- Lego World: Lego brick-built environment
- Isometric Map: hand-drawn isometric schematic diagram

### Creative
- Food Infographic: detailed editorial food illustration
- Risograph Icons: risograph-print icon collection
- Metallic Logo: dark metallic logo design
- Anime: Japanese anime style illustration
- Sci-Fi: futuristic neon glow aesthetic
- Hong Kong: retro Hong Kong cinema look
- Oil Painting: classic canvas texture
- Watercolor: soft painted washes

## Technology
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite
- AI Models: FLUX Kontext Pro, Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2 (via Replicate)
- Storage: Supabase (Postgres + Storage)
- Auth: Supabase Auth (Google OAuth)
- Deployment: Vercel (Serverless Functions + SPA)
